claims.object_text: α subunit of the delayed rectifier voltage-dependent potassium channel Kv 2.1
claims.quote: KCNB1 encodes the α subunit of the delayed rectifier voltage-dependent potassium channel Kv 2.1.
Most variants occur de novo and mainly consist of missense variants located on the voltage sensor and the pore domain of Kv 2.1.
KCNB1-related encephalopathies encompass a wide spectrum of neurodevelopmental disorders with predominant language difficulties and behavioral impairment.
